source.title: The number of string C-groups of high rank

locators.false_converse: physical p. 6, Proposition 2.4 and final displayed equality
locators.preserved_forward: physical p. 6, Proposition 2.2, attributed there to [9, Proposition 3.3]

claim: The general converse in literal Proposition 2.4 is false: (a,b,ab) in C2^2 is not C, while (a tau,b,ab) is a basis marking of C2^3.

written_proof.assumptions: Three distinct nonidentity involutions with string commutations; tau outside and central. No independent original marking is required by source definition.

excluded: No disproof of Theorem 6.4 or the main stability theorem.
No challenge to forward endpoint extension or the accepted L010 applications.
No claim about a converse with independent original generators or noncommuting adjacent generators.
No full L019 recovery, open-conjecture answer, historical-priority claim, or length ratio.
